sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Halloween: Unexpected Help is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "While Therapist and her clever little lot are still pissing about, checking things and scratching their heads, I've already sorted the problem. Got my hands on a proper vaccine, not some homebrew rubbish. The people who supplied it know their stuff. I've been working with 'em for years. They reckon it was developed during the last outbreak, but it never made it to Tarkov back then. Guess it was waiting for me! Right, enough jawing. Pick up a batch from the treatment facilities at Lighthouse and stash it in the two-storey dorms on Customs. Someone's waiting for it there. And don't you bloody lose that shipment, or I'll wring your neck."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the vaccine shipment at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
- Stash the vaccine shipment in room 105 of the two-story dorm on Customs

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +38,000 EXP
- 2,700 Euros
  - 2,835 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 3,105 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Ammunition case
"My lads have already picked up the goods. Lovely stuff! Now the money'll come rolling in! What, you thought I was doing this out of the goodness of my heart, did ya?"

sections.heading: Failure Dialogue
sections.text: "Oi, you fucker! Decided to do this the hard way, did ya?"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| TG-VI-26 vaccine batch | 1 | Required | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
| Dorm room 105 key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks dorm room 105 in the two story dorms on Customs where the TG-VI-26 vaccine batch has to be stashed |
In this quest you first have to locate and obtain the vaccine shipment on Lighthouse. It can be found on the second floor of water treatment building no. 3, on a desk in the western office.

Afterwards it has to be stashed in room 105 of the two story dorms on Customs. A Dorm room 105 key is required to enter it.
